approach: Each refresh is a Markdown procedure in procedures/ whose mechanical steps are one command, npm run refresh -- <id>, backed by small Node scripts that copy source files verbatim into sources/<short>/ with a per-procedure lock of repository, commit and SHA-256. A run verifies with the site's build/check plus a source-record check, then creates or updates the pull request of its fixed refresh/<short> branch; an hourly workflow runs the same command with a GitHub App token.

decisions.decision: Procedures are Markdown documents; mechanics are Node scripts behind npm run refresh
decisions.why: Deterministic copying/diffing makes first-run PRs pass checks and lets automatic runs work without an LLM in CI
decisions.rejected: Prose-only procedures executed by an agent; a Claude skill per procedure

decisions.decision: Commit verbatim source copies under sources/<short>/ with one source.lock.json per procedure
decisions.why: PR diffs show the actual changed text, builds are offline and reproducible, and concurrent refresh PRs never touch the same file
decisions.rejected: Git submodules; fetching at build time from pinned SHAs; one shared lock file

decisions.decision: Hourly scheduled poll in this repository, plus workflow_dispatch and optional repository_dispatch
decisions.why: Meets run-on-source-change without adding workflows or secrets to five other repositories
decisions.rejected: Push-based repository_dispatch from each source as the only trigger

decisions.decision: GitHub App installation token for automatic runs
decisions.why: Four sources are private and PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger CI
decisions.rejected: GITHUB_TOKEN; fine-grained personal access token (kept as stopgap)

decisions.decision: Fixed branch refresh/<procedure>, rebuilt from develop and force-pushed each run
decisions.why: Makes finding and updating the open PR from an earlier run a simple lookup (FR-008)
decisions.rejected: A new dated branch per run

decisions.decision: Unmapped states or unlinked screenshots exit 3 with a decision file; interactive runs ask via selection, automatic runs open a Refresh blocked issue
decisions.why: These are the only questions a source cannot answer, and answers land as reviewed mapping changes
decisions.rejected: Guessing a mapping; failing without a question

plan.summary: Five Markdown procedures backed by npm run refresh; verbatim sources/ copies with locks; hourly App-token workflow; PRs on fixed refresh/* branches; contracts for CLI, PR body, lock schema and site integration.
